Show a plan or the state as OpenTofu's machine-readable document — `tofu show -json`. A plan is a convergence round's, as the engine captured it when the round sealed: the document at plan.uri, which this reads. The state is read from the engine's records of the workspace. Values the document marks sensitive print as '\_\_cty_sensitive\_\_' unless show_sensitive.

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** read · plan · apply · full

## Annotations

| Annotation | Value |
|---|---|
| `readOnlyHint` | true |
| `destructiveHint` | false |
| `idempotentHint` | false |
| `openWorldHint` | true |

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace_alias` | string | no | Workspace alias, as 'open' named it. Omit for the workspace opened without an alias ('default'), however many others are open. |
| `what` | string | no | 'plan' (default): a convergence round's plan; 'state': the workspace's state. |
| `convergence_id` | string | no | For a plan: the convergence (default: the one holding the workspace). |
| `round` | integer | no | For a plan: the round (default: the round waiting at its approval point, else the latest). |
| `planfile` | string | no | For a plan: a planfile's ref (planfile.ref of a planned result) — the planned round's document, the one plan_digest names when apply applies it. convergence_id and round are then not read. |
| `show_sensitive` | boolean | no | Print sensitive values in the clear instead of '\_\_cty_sensitive\_\_' (default false). Only when you need the secret: it enters the conversation. A plan read so is the document plan.digest hashes. |
